answer_1.quote: We focus on generating simplified journalistic summaries of scientific papers for the non-technical general audience ... we introduce a new dataset, SCITECHNEWS, which pairs full scientific papers with their corresponding press release articles ...

answer_2.quote: The informativeness, relevance, and fluency of the generated summaries are evaluated using ROUGE 1, 2, and L, respectively. Semantic relevance is evaluated with BertScore ... Faithfulness is quantified using QuestEval ... readability metrics (CLI, FKGL) and a style score are also reported.

answer_4.quote: We take a random sample of 30 items from the test set and conduct a study using Best-Worst Scaling ... Human subjects were shown the source document ... They were asked to choose the best and the worst according to the following dimensions: (1) Informativeness, (2) Factuality, (3) Non-Redundancy, (4) Readability, (5) Style, and (6) Usefulness.
answer_4.guideline: Best-Worst Scaling with multiple dimensions (Informativeness, Factuality, Non-Redundancy, Readability, Style, Usefulness) evaluated by human annotators.
